data.message: I commit to 18 tons, an individual opt-in, not a unanimity deal. Each of the other 24: state your exact intended catch and any conditions. Switching 10→18 earns $8,000 extra if fulfilled. If k choose18 and others10, catch=250+8k, leaving250−8k; next stock is500 (75%) or500−16k (25%). All18 leaves50, with next stock500 or100—not risk-free or guaranteed best long-term. Intentions aren't binding; other catches require recalculation. Fellow recruiters, help seek individual choices.
